{{Quote|I'm no ordinary civilian. I'm a businessman, a man of the galaxy. And, if I may say so, a brilliant&mdash;and handsome&mdash;inventor.|Tarkos Sund|<ref name="TTOD" />}}
'''Tarkos Sund''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman and inventor who founded [[Sund Technologies]], a technology company during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A thrillseeker, Sund sought to acquire a [[prototype accelerator]] that was said to have been lost in the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] three centuries earlier, but his attempts to recover the device from the [[Tularan Marsh]] was stymied by native wildlife. Sund turned to other individuals in the area, who successfully retrieved the accelerator for him.
